Stock market news | Sensex drops 1,484 points as profit booking hits markets

On 23 November 2026, the Sensex fell 1,484 points and the Nifty dropped 451 points, wiping out more than ₹5 lakh crore of investor wealth. Both indices slipped nearly 2%.
Profit booking after a strong rally, especially in banking stocks, drove the sell-off. PSU bank shares fell up to 5% and the Nifty Bank index slipped over 4%, prompting caution among investors.
